description: Versioned failure-signature catalog for the agent run evidence pipeline (IRE #41 P4). Each entry names one detector, its version, thresholds, and a proposed fix. Every fix starts as 'proposed'; only a verification experiment (#40 M0.5 / M0.6) may move it on. Detectors read harness-neutral modeled facts, so they apply to Codex, Kilo and OpenCode runs alike unless 'applies_to' narrows them.

exclusions.note: Pipeline verification traces (collector checks, e2e wrapper tests, 11133 capture checks) are not agent runs.

signatures.description: A run was killed or timed out while it still showed liveness: a command was in flight (started, never completed), or the last event came less than live_threshold_s before the end. #40 violation detectors 1 and 2.

proposed_fix.summary: Replace fixed wall-clock caps with an idle threshold over child events and process activity (#40 H: liveness).

signatures.description: A launcher receipt has agent events but no terminal event, no exit code and no kill record: the process ended (or was stopped) without the launcher closing out the run, so the cause is not recorded.

proposed_fix.summary: Write summary/exit metadata from a finally block and record the stopping actor when the launcher itself is stopped.

signatures.description: The provider rejected a request with a 4xx status and a provider error code (for example 11133 model_param_invalid, HTTP 400). One incident per root run and code; request ids and request-shape counts are kept as metrics.

proposed_fix.summary: Fuzz the request shape one factor at a time and add a request-normalization fix or documented workaround (#40 M0.6).

signatures.description: After a provider parameter rejection, a follow-up run in the same session chain (resume or fresh launch linked by prior session) hit the same provider error code again. #40 violation detector 6.

proposed_fix.summary: Classify known provider parameter rejections as non-retryable until the request shape changes.

signatures.mast_mode: MAST FM-1.5 unaware of termination conditions
signatures.description: At least min_runs runs in one session chain within window_min minutes, with at least min_failures that did not complete.

proposed_fix.summary: Bound resumes per session and require a classified cause before another resume.

signatures.description: The launcher recorded an error (launcher-error.txt), or a top-level run failed or was killed within early_exit_s without a provider error code, before any agent work.

proposed_fix.summary: Do not treat Codex stderr warnings as fatal under PowerShell 5.1 ErrorActionPreference=Stop; verify the model route before launch.

signatures.description: A top-level run failed (non-zero exit) but no provider error, launcher error, kill or early exit explains it. The cause was not captured.

proposed_fix.summary: Scan receipts at run end and put provider.error.* on the launcher root span (IRE #44).

signatures.description: The same command (by hash) ran at least min_repeats times in one run, or wait/status-poll commands made up at least min_poll_share of the run's commands (and at least min_poll_commands).

proposed_fix.summary: Wait on child events or a bounded watch command instead of re-running status checks.

signatures.description: A gap of at least min_gap_s with no events inside a run, ended by a later event (not by the run end).

proposed_fix.summary: Correlate long gaps with process CPU/IO to separate quiet work from real hangs.

signatures.description: A tool call was denied by the permission or sandbox policy. #40 M5 permission_denied detector.

proposed_fix.summary: Verify the permission mode per hop at first response (#40 M5).

signatures.description: A child hop requested one model route but a different route was observed (fallback). #40 violation detector 4; #32.

proposed_fix.summary: Stop the hop when the first response shows a route other than the requested one (#32).

signatures.description: A child hop that ran at least min_child_wall_s produced no streamed output visible to its parent. #40 violation detector 3.

proposed_fix.summary: Launch task owners in a streaming mode and tee child events.
